title: Preparing DNA Samples from Mixed Sand Prior to Extraction
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sv8ee9w

steps.title: Prepare Pot and Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the sand sample for collection by adding water and removing debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL MilliQ water to the pot.
Remove any plants and transfer them to a square petri dish.

steps.title: Collect Sand Sample
steps.instruction: Extract sand from the pot using a 50 mL Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Push a 50 mL Falcon tube into the sand up to the 35 mL mark.
Tilt the pot to a horizontal position and remove the tube, rotating it if necessary to retain as much sand as possible.

steps.title: Clean and Label Tube
steps.instruction: Sanitize the exterior of the collection tube and label it.

substeps.instruction: Wipe down the tube exterior using a paper towel with 70% EtOH.
Label the tube with the pot ID.

steps.title: Wash and Homogenize Sand
steps.instruction: Dilute the sand sample and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Fill the tube with sand to the 40 mL mark using MilliQ water (top up to 40 mL total volume with ultrapure water).

steps.title: Filter and Concentrate Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the mixture and centrifuge to pellet the DNA/material.

substeps.instruction: Pour the mixture through Miracloth into a new 50 mL tube and discard the old tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 5000 x G for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend and Transfer Sample
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and transfer to a smaller tube for storage or extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL water and vortex to resuspend.
Transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL tube for extraction or storage.
